run_pddm_expand: run pddm on a source file to expand PDDM macro directives into debuggable code
run_pddm_dry_run: run pddm in dry-run mode to check if a source file needs macro expansion updates
run_pddm_collapse: run pddm with collapse option to remove all generated macro expansion code from a file
create_macrocollection_parse: create a MacroCollection and parse macro definitions from a file-like stream
create_macrocollection_expand: create a MacroCollection and expand a macro reference string like foo(a, b) into code
